clauses.statement: TenantContextEnvelopeはcanonical snake_caseで、schema_version:'1.0'、protocol_id:'mana-brainbase-tenant-context'、protocol_version:'1.0'、issuer:'brainbase'、audience:string[]、tenant:{tenant_id:'ten_'+ULID,tenant_revision:string}、workspace_connection:{connection_id:'wsc_'+ULID,connection_revision:string,provider:'slack',installation_id:string,workspace_id:string,app_id:string,status:'active'}、actor:{principal_id:string,principal_type:'person'|'service',authenticated_subject_id:string,delegated_by?:string}、authorization:{organization_ids:string[],project_ids:string[],data_scopes:string[],capability_ids:string[]}、placement:{deployment_id:'dep_'+ULID,profile:'shared_cloud'|'dedicated_cloud'|'customer_managed_oss'}、slack:{event_id:string,channel_id:string,enterprise_id?:string,thread_ts?:string,requester_id?:string}、correlation_id:'cor_'+ULID、operation_id:'op_'+ULID、idempotency_key:'ik1_'+base64url、contract_revision:string、credential:{mode:'cloud_standard'|'customer_oauth'|'customer_api',credential_ref:string,billing_principal_id:string}、issued_at、expires_at、integrity:{method:'jws_detached',algorithm:'EdDSA',key_id:string,value:string}を必須とする。integrityを除くJSONをRFC 8785 JCSでcanonicalizeし、BrainbaseのEd25519 detached compact JWS（protected header alg=EdDSA、kid、typ='application/mana-tenant-context+jws'）で検証する。TTLは300秒以下、clock skewは30秒以下とし、validatorはfieldを変更・補完・延命しない。raw secret類は禁止する。

clauses.statement: validate_tenant_boundary({boundary,envelope,authoritative_snapshot,expected_scope,now})をWorker ingress、Queue consumer、Durable Object、Container launch、MCP gateway、Brainbase proxy、Slack deliveryの7境界で必ず呼ぶ。各validatorはschema、protocol、JWS、TTL/skew、tenant、connection、contract revision、placement、workspace/channel/thread、actor/project/capability scopeを再照合し、TenantBoundaryError {boundary,code}を返す。入口に加えcredential lease、Brainbase write、Slack deliveryの直前はcache hintでなくauthoritative expected-revision readを必須とする。失敗codeはTENANT_CONTEXT_SIGNATURE_INVALID、TENANT_CONTEXT_EXPIRED、TENANT_UNKNOWN、TENANT_AMBIGUOUS、WORKSPACE_CONNECTION_REVOKED、WORKSPACE_CONNECTION_STALE_REVISION、WORKSPACE_CONNECTION_UNAVAILABLE、WORKSPACE_OR_APP_MISMATCH、ACTOR_SCOPE_MISMATCH、PROJECT_SCOPE_MISMATCH、CAPABILITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH、CROSS_TENANT_CANDIDATE、PROTOCOL_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED、PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTEDとし、Containerとモデルの主張は正本に採用しない。

clauses.statement: idempotency_keyはLP(v)=uint32be(UTF8 byte length)+UTF8として、'ik1_'+base64url_no_padding(SHA-256(LP(protocol_id)||LP(protocol_major)||LP(tenant_id)||LP(connection_id)||LP(slack_event_id)||LP(operation_id)))で生成する。IdempotencyClaim {key,tenant_id,connection_id,slack_event_id,operation_id,context_hash,payload_hash,state:'pending'|'claimed'|'succeeded'|'failed_terminal',lease_until?,result_ref?,connection_revision,updated_at}をtenant partition内で原子的にclaimし、terminal stateを30日以上保持する。Brainbase writeとSlack deliveryは同じcorrelation配下の別operation_idで最大1回にする。retryは同じkeyを維持し、claim後のcontext_hashまたはpayload_hash不一致はIDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT、revision変更はfresh contextへ再解決する。
